name: OlympiadBench
intro: OlympiadBench 是包含 8,476 道中英文数学与物理竞赛/高考题的双语多模态基准。论文 v2 从三类公开竞赛材料收集题目，经 Mathpix OCR、人工核验、专家级问题—解答—答案结构化、向量去重和人工标签整理；开放题进入确定答案自动评分，定理证明题仅单独做人工抽样评估。
build_method: 三类公开竞赛材料筛选, Mathpix OCR 与逐题人工校核, 专家问题—解答—答案结构化, 向量去重与题型/子领域标注
metric: 开放题微平均 Accuracy（数值、表达式、方程、区间与元组等价判分；仅以可用回答为分母）；定理证明题仅人工抽样
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 数学问题, 开放式问答, 定理证明
eval_feature: 双语, 多模态, 专家级逐步解答, 数值与符号等价判分
scale: 8,476 题：开放题 6,728、定理证明题 1,748、含图 4,869；固定 Hugging Face 快照含 18 个配置、每个仅有名为 train 的打包 split，共 24 列
task_type_en: Math Problems, Open-ended QA, Theorem Proving
build_method_en: Three public competition-source families, Mathpix OCR plus item-level manual verification, expert Problem-Solution-Answer structuring, embedding deduplication, and manual type/subfield labels
eval_feature_en: Bilingual, multimodal, expert step-by-step solutions, numeric and symbolic equivalence scoring
intro_en: OlympiadBench is a bilingual multimodal benchmark of 8,476 Chinese and English mathematics and physics competition/CEE problems. Paper v2 curates three public source families through Mathpix OCR, manual verification, expert Problem-Solution-Answer structuring, embedding deduplication, and manual labels; definitive-answer open-ended items enter automatic scoring, while theorem proofs receive separate manual sample assessment only.
scale_en: 8,476 records: 6,728 open-ended, 1,748 theorem-proving, and 4,869 image-bearing; the fixed Hugging Face snapshot has 18 Hugging Face configurations, each with one train-labelled split used for packaging, and 24 columns
metric_en: Micro-average accuracy for open-ended definitive answers (numeric, expression, equation, interval, and tuple equivalence; available-response denominator); theorem proofs are manually sample-assessed only

drawio_review_note:
reviewed_at=2026-07-18. Primary-paper boundary: OlympiadBench, arXiv 2402.14008v2, fixed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14008v2 and https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.14008v2. The downloaded v2 PDF has SHA-256 4360149145ef6c5d506cf6cd82d0214208b6572c654a6d932d7cfc010817e5f7. The construction diagram follows the paper's data-collection and evaluation sections. It starts from three disclosed source families: global mathematics and physics Olympiads, Chinese regional and national mathematics competitions, and Gaokao mock mathematics and physics examinations. Contests and years are selected for difficulty, volume, publicly obtainable materials, language, discipline, and broad year coverage. Official PDFs are converted with Mathpix OCR into Markdown text and formulae while retaining embedded images; human curators compare conversion output against the PDFs, clean and revise errors, and protect scientific notation. Each item is structured as Problem-Solution-Answer with expert step-by-step solutions. The project vectorizes records with Laurie/Bloom1b7-deepspeed-chat-Chinese-math and removes cosine-similar duplicates; neither paper nor fixed public code discloses a numeric deduplication threshold, so the diagram says that directly. Curators manually annotate open-ended versus theorem-proving type and subfield metadata. Progressive physics items keep shared material and dependencies in context. Definitive answers are typed as numeric, expression, equation, interval, or tuple, with multiple-answer, unit, and per-item error metadata retained.

Fixed public-data boundary: the official repository is https://github.com/OpenBMB/OlympiadBench/tree/ba5b26a7e2849940b598a9159c1190daa2b9175f at commit ba5b26a7e2849940b598a9159c1190daa2b9175f; no release tag was used. Its LICENSE has SHA-256 3731ca9a793c1a65139ddfbb80db653c12d9ad9f01efead6395afb08a040976c and identifies Apache-2.0. README.md has SHA-256 e113ccb1a464ba76f05786832017cf58122478d849f3198b2829104b948635d3. The official Hugging Face dataset Hothan/OlympiadBench is pinned at revision 91184b52131e7fc9455fef848035173aea8cc01a. The API snapshot JSON has SHA-256 df497740708f2f957c2f83c97e5b1c063793906ca8679a09e637b2e3a6ef7379, the recursive tree manifest has SHA-256 153c7971ac59e165002f1d68c255a303f74367c7fa69e09a78270d7df515b6e7, the size endpoint has SHA-256 ae8cc319f5937dd7915bddf537719dd456fad692c1dcdf860e020b3ae2e6258f, and the schema/first-row API capture has SHA-256 9f8945191b4106635df49822121aae8d2967ed914e76979c27fe2027673fb302. This fixed snapshot has exactly 8,476 records: 6,728 open-ended and 1,748 theorem-proving; 4,869 multimodal and 3,607 text-only; 6,142 mathematics and 2,334 physics; 2,125 English and 6,351 Chinese; 2,869 competition and 5,607 CEE records. It publishes 18 configurations, each with a single train-labelled split; that label is Hugging Face packaging, not a training split or permission to train on evaluation data. The schema has 24 columns: id, question, solution, final_answer, context, image_1 through image_9, modality, difficulty, is_multiple_answer, unit, answer_type, error, question_type, subfield, subject, and language.

Evaluation boundary: the common bilingual zero-shot template injects subject and answer type, requires LaTeX reasoning and a boxed final answer, and does not reveal knowledge labels. The theorem-proof prompt is separate. Open-ended questions with definitive answers enter automatic scoring; theorem proofs are only manually assessed on samples and do not receive a full automatic score. English output extraction first looks for the final-answer phrase So the final answer is, Chinese extraction looks for 所以最终答案是, and fallback logic looks for boxed content or last-line mathematics; DeepSeek-specific markers are handled separately. Structured comparison separates commas outside brackets, expands plus-minus alternatives, applies the per-item error or a default 1e-8 tolerance, and dispatches interval, numeric, expression, equation, and SymPy-equivalence checks. The fixed scorer also considers percentage variants, symbolic residuals below 1e-3, and integer-ratio equation equivalence. eval/auto_scoring_judge.py has SHA-256 e189460aa1e660d388e00cceebf1568bde2356ecc6ef555a4ef6f2475fdd6585; inference/code/math_judger.py has SHA-256 d19fee0db997aeccf0768eca8de7061207ea68cd060bbc678e1ba8d8912d7888; inference/judge.py has SHA-256 7fd8566d5706ecf565708128d6d66b9c875fcba117d740744df712f5aa082a64; inference/calculate_accuracy.py has SHA-256 9d4334ca3ed68305f7d08d0fa76465c7c7725d8b8db96a98277d55aa0c4ff057; inference/code/evaluators/evaluator.py has SHA-256 1db73b7a8379a79c9163beb7f13aa02077e90c3f946554daabdc677d6468817f. calculate_accuracy.py skips theorem-proving files and excludes empty, unavailable, inappropriate, and API-error responses, so its denominator is available responses rather than all 8,476 records; this matches the paper's statement that unavailable responses are removed.

Publication drift is recorded instead of erased. The repository README says the data were updated on 2024-07-17, while the pinned Hugging Face revision is later but preserves the paper counts. The inference README says the reported experiments used this code, although prompts were slightly adjusted for publication because dataset item names changed. The diagrams therefore show a prompt-wording boundary and distinguish the repository's categorized JSON-folder expectation from Hugging Face's Parquet, 18-configuration, train-labelled packaging. Formal publication evidence [site-a12a-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2605×925 (English) and 2605×925 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2603×923 and 2603×923. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
